title: 化學機械平坦化
summary: 從移除量與平坦度、碟陷與侵蝕到整合驗收：以 12 項工程決策、24 個模型與診斷工作包建立證據。
summaryEn: From Removal versus planarity and Dishing and erosion to Integration acceptance: build evidence through twelve engineering decisions and twenty-four modeling/diagnostic work packages.
scope: 公開原理的教學拆解：12 個技術主題各有模型／分析及故障／驗證兩步，共四階段 24 步。不是 24 道實際製造配方，也不是任何廠商量產流程。數值由學員自訂並標示為假設；涉及材料加工、高壓、雷射或化學品的活動僅做圖上與資料分析，不由網頁授權實機操作。
scopeEn: A public-principles educational decomposition: twelve technical topics each have a model/analysis step and a diagnosis/verification step, organized as four stages and twenty-four work packages. These are not twenty-four fabrication recipes or a manufacturer flow. Learner-selected numbers are hypothetical; materials processing, high voltage, lasers and chemicals are studied through diagrams/data, not authorized physical operation.

stages.title: 移除量與平坦度 → 晶圓徑向控制
stages.titleEn: Removal versus planarity to Radial wafer control
stages.description: 把「移除量與平坦度」「Preston 近似」「晶圓徑向控制」各拆成模型與診斷兩項工作，保留可檢查成果。
stages.descriptionEn: Develop model and diagnostic deliverables for Removal versus planarity, Preston approximation, Radial wafer control.

steps.title: 移除量與平坦度：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Removal versus planarity: construct and analyze
steps.objective: 用可檢查的成果說明「均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化」。
steps.objectiveEn: Demonstrate the following with inspectable work: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.
steps.instruction:
畫三點研磨前後高度並分算移除量和剩餘高差。先標出輸入、輸出與適用假設；依圖形、計算或比較表完成推理；把估算、來源事實與待量測項分開。所有自行設定數值均標為教學假設。

具體算例（全部數值為教學假設）：假設同一高度基準下三個配對測點研磨前為 110、100、90 nm，研磨後為 75、70、65 nm。逐點移除量為 35、30、25 nm，平均 30 nm；表面高度極差由 20 降為 10 nm。請分別畫高度與移除量，不把平均移除量當成平坦度；三點不足以代表整片晶圓。
steps.instructionEn:
Draw before/after heights at three sites and calculate removal separately from residual height difference. Mark inputs, outputs and assumptions; complete the diagram, calculation or comparison; separate estimates, source facts and measurements still needed. Label all chosen values as hypothetical.

Worked example (all values are hypothetical teaching inputs): Assume three matched sites share one height datum: before polishing 110, 100 and 90 nm; after 75, 70 and 65 nm. Removal is 35, 30 and 25 nm, averaging 30 nm; surface-height range falls from 20 to 10 nm. Plot height and removal separately. Mean removal is not flatness, and three sites do not characterize a wafer.
steps.observation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
steps.observationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.
steps.failure: 若採用「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」，先回到前一步模型，檢查假設、量測條件及本步的診斷因素。
steps.failureEn: If using the claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization", return to the model and check assumptions, measurement conditions and the diagnostic factor.
steps.check:
提交「移除量與平坦度」的圖表或計算、單位與至少一項假設；成果須能追溯到本步指定的輸入和輸出，並說明：均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化。
算例驗收：驗算平均移除 30 nm、殘餘高度極差 10 nm，並標出配對測點與共同基準。
steps.checkEn:
Submit the Removal versus planarity diagram/table or calculation with units and at least one assumption, tracing inputs to outputs and explaining: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography.
Worked-example acceptance: Verify 30 nm mean removal and 10 nm residual height range; identify matched sites and the common datum.

steps.title: 移除量與平坦度：故障判讀與驗證
steps.titleEn: Removal versus planarity: diagnose and verify
steps.objective: 以新增對照檢查「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」這項錯誤主張。
steps.objectiveEn: Test the faulty claim: Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization.
steps.instruction: 接續前一步「移除量與平坦度」成果，先指出錯誤主張「把所有位置厚度同減視為已平坦」漏掉哪個條件。新增診斷原理：配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。據此設計一組正常與異常對照；指定可區分兩者的觀察量、取樣位置或時間；寫下證據不足時應保留的未決結論。不得虛構實測數字。
steps.instructionEn: Continue the preceding Removal versus planarity artifact. Identify the missing condition in the faulty claim "Treating equal thickness reduction everywhere as planarization". Introduce this diagnostic principle: Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error. Design normal/fault controls; specify a distinguishing observable, sampling location or time; state what remains undecided without evidence. Do not fabricate measurements.
steps.observation: 均勻移除不保證原有地形被平坦化；配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差。
steps.observationEn: Uniform removal need not flatten existing topography; Matched sites reduce spatial mismatch error.

steps.check: 交出「移除量與平坦度」的正常／異常比較、可觀察量與一項仍未確定事項；必須解釋「配對測點可降低空間錯配誤差」如何改變前一步的判讀。
